home.title: Parking in the Zona Colonial

home.signedInSubtitle: Manage the vehicles on your account.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: We could not find what you were looking for. The link may be incomplete, or the page may no longer exist.

unavailable.title: Sign-up is unavailable
unavailable.body: We could not load the legal texts, so we cannot create accounts right now. Try again in a moment.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.intro: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a code to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, we sent a code.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Enter the code we sent you and your new password.

vehicles.title: My vehicles
vehicles.capReached: You reached the limit of {limit} vehicles. Delete one to add another.

empty.title: Add your first car
empty.body: Register your plate so you can reserve a space.

loadError.title: We could not load your vehicles

form.plateHint: Type it any way you like: spaces and dashes are ignored.

password.title: Password
password.body: To change your password we send a code to your email.

danger.title: Delete account
danger.body: This permanently deletes your account, your personal data and your vehicles. It cannot be undone.

unavailable.title: Your session is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: We could not refresh your session right now. Your account is safe. Try again in a moment.

legalGate.body: To keep using MyPark, read and accept the current texts.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: This section is only for administrators.

admin.title: Administration
admin.body: You are in the MyPark administration area.

acceptInvitation.title: Activate your administrator account
acceptInvitation.intro: Enter the code from your invitation and choose a password.

legal.demoNotice: Sample text for an academic demo.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: This service lets you register vehicles and reserve parking spaces in the Zona Colonial. You agree to provide accurate information and to use the service only for your own vehicles.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We store your name, email, phone number and vehicle plates to run the service. We do not share them with third parties, and you can delete your account at any time.
